svg.title: F33-4 Quick-reference sheet 4: administrative time limits
svg.text: What to prove in the registers
1. Each register field states working days or calendar days.
2. The RFI clock starts when the RFI moves from draft to open; the NCR clock starts on the day it is raised.
3. The change register holds the 28-day and 84-day FIDIC dates from the day of awareness.
F33-4 Quick-reference sheet 4: administrative time limits
RFI 2, 5 and 10 working days · submittal 10 or 15 working days · IR notice 24 h · NCR containment 1 day, correction 10 or 5 days · FIDIC claim 28 and 84 days · NEC4 8 weeks
• A FIDIC Notice of Claim is sent no later than 28 days after awareness, and the fully detailed Claim within 84 days.
• A P1 RFI is answered in 2 working days, with a verbal answer the same day.
